distribution_assumption: distribution model undecided (owner, 2026-11-27); must stay commercially distributable: only commercial-use licenses, geodata bundled in shipped builds

decision_values.bundle: may ship in game builds with the listed obligations
decision_values.bundle-filtered: may ship only the subset passing the listed filter
decision_values.conditional: may ship only after the per-item check in conditions passes
decision_values.tooling-only: may be used by offline import/validation tools; never shipped, never merged into shipped data
decision_values.exclude: must not be imported or shipped

sources.name: Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank)
sources.coverage: global historical polities, 3400 BC - 2024 AD (frame years)
obligations: credit creators (Ed Chalstrey, James Bennett; Seshat Global History Databank) with DOI and license in game credits and data notice
conditions: before import: check release notes/README inside the archive for sub-sources with different terms
record sha256 of the downloaded archive here
sources.notes: Zenodo lists the record as software; the archive contains the polity geometries. Primary historical source.

sources.name: historical-basemaps (A. Ourednik)
obligations: copyleft: derived data must stay GPL-3.0
conditions: secondary comparison in offline validation only
no geometry, attribute or derived boundary may enter shipped data
sources.notes: Origins of individual layers are not documented with licenses (README: collected and adapted from diverse sources); README calls the maps work in progress.

sources.name: OpenHistoricalMap
sources.version: live database (snapshot date to record at export)
sources.coverage: dated regional geometries, roads, settlements; no complete global yearly coverage
obligations: attribution not required; credit 'OpenHistoricalMap contributors' anyway
conditions: import only elements without a license= tag or with license=CC0
exclude elements tagged CC BY-SA and OSM-derived coastline/water data (CC BY-SA 2.0)
exclude sources with unstated license (e.g. ANR COMMUNES)
sources.notes: Per-element exceptions are documented via license= tags.

sources.name: CShapes 2.0 (ETH Zurich ICR)
obligations: cite Schvitz et al. 2022, Journal of Conflict Resolution 66(1)
conditions: NonCommercial term is incompatible with a commercial game; not even for tooling that produces shipped data
sources.notes: May be consulted manually as literature, not imported.

sources.name: Natural Earth Admin 0 Countries 1:10m
sources.coverage: modern country boundaries (not a day-accurate border state)
obligations: none; optional credit 'Made with Natural Earth'
conditions: do not import the third-party layers with separate release notes (Washington Post, EC JRC rivers/lakes Europe, XNR roads, IMA time zones)
disputed areas handled per Natural Earth disputed-boundaries policy (source H)
sources.notes: Modern reference layer only; not projected onto earlier centuries.

sources.name: geoBoundaries (gbOpen)
obligations: credit 'geoBoundaries' with link www.geoboundaries.org in game credits
cite Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866
conditions: per-boundary license record must be CC BY 4.0 (or more permissive) to ship
ODbL boundaries only as separately shipped database with ODbL notice, otherwise excluded
global composites (CGAZ) excluded until their license is documented
sources.notes: Site states aim for full CC BY compatibility in 2027; re-check at import.

sources.name: Cliopatria methodology article (Scientific Data)
sources.notes: Method and limits of reconstruction; not a primary source. Page not re-checked in this review.

sources.name: Natural Earth disputed boundaries policy
sources.notes: De facto / de jure handling; our cartographic decision must be documented per dispute. Page not re-checked in this review.
